introduction: Ohio unemployment compensation provides temporary payments to eligible workers after qualifying unemployment. The state decides monetary and weekly eligibility separately.
description: Ohio unemployment compensation provides temporary payments to eligible workers after qualifying unemployment. The state decides monetary and weekly eligibility separately.

sections.who: Work and wage history, separation circumstances and weekly eligibility affect the claim. Generally you must be able, available and seeking suitable work unless an exception applies.
sections.get: Approved weekly payments replace part of lost earnings. Filing an initial claim alone does not establish entitlement for every later week.
sections.docs:
• Identity and contact information.
  • Recent employer details, work dates and wage records.
  • The reason employment ended and any requested supporting evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Open the claim

    Use Ohio claimant self-service with an OHID, or call 877-644-6562.

  2. Complete verification

    Certify the application and follow identity-verification instructions.

  3. File weekly requests

    Answer the weekly questions accurately, including earnings and work-search information.
sections.after: Read every determination and request for information. Keep filing eligible weeks as instructed while a decision is pending; follow any appeal notice if you disagree.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State filing policy; Ohio benefit eligibility statute; Claimant portal. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the employer tax portal for my claim?
Yes. The claimant portal requires employment and self-employment earnings to be reported.
Does the first application cover future weeks?
No. Weekly claims and continuing eligibility are separate requirements.
